headlines.title: Game studio Gardens Interactive raised a $35M+ Series B led by Lightspeed at a pre-money valuation of $190M, taking its total funding to $71M (Cecilia D'Anastasio/Bloomberg)
Healthleap, which makes AI screening software to identify patients at risk of undiagnosed illnesses, raised $38M across a $30M Series A and an $8M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
Nous Research, which makes the open-source Hermes AI agent that has hit 22M+ downloads since February, raised $90M at a $1.2B valuation to expand to enterprises (Yuliya Chernova/Wall Street Journal)
North American startup funding hit $92B in Q3, down 35% QoQ but up 50% YoY, with $61B to AI startups; there were 11 $1B+ acquisitions and IPOs remained quiet (Joanna Glasner/Crunchbase News)
From Ballet To Breach Prevention: How A Magician’s Son Raised $4.2M In Seed Funding For His Cybersecurity Startup
Parallel Systems, which builds autonomous freight trains, raised a $100M Series C led by AVP, taking its total funding to $200M+ (Tim De Chant/TechCrunch)
Google launches SynthID Detector, a website that lets users detect AI-generated image, video, and audio media across dozens of common file formats (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
Owkin alum raises $25m seed to build world model for human cells
Another personal AI assistant has launched — Meet Tab, which emerged from stealth with a $300M valuation
North America’s Startup Funding Falls In Q3 As AI Giants Eye The Public Markets
Fast-growing Temporal hires team from NYC startup Oso to build AI agent security controls
Tech Moves: Microsoft CVP retires; former Amazon SVP to lead Boston Dynamics; Qualtrics, Overland AI, Fred Hutch name execs
Spiko raises $90m in Series B backed by Index Ventures and Speedinvest
SAP to acquire AI startup TechWolf for undisclosed sum
DoorDash’s Tony Xu says AI agents will increase demand for human labour
Meta rolls out AI tools to find ads that secretly lead users to CSAM and says it took action against 33.2M pieces of child exploitation content in H1 2026 (Lauren Forristal/TechCrunch)
The Apple Watch Series 12 is a good deal at $50 off
SpaceX petition on launch spectrum meets opposition from aerospace and healthcare
OpenAI publishes 722 maths papers written by a model it has not released
Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
Google invests millions in Mark Zuckerberg’s efforts to create a ‘virtual cell’
Elon Musk says Grok Bot will use the "best back end model for any given task, including Claude Opus 5.5, MidJourney, Suno" (Grace Kay/The Information)
OpenAI’s Alexander Embiricos is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — days after the launch of Dots
Amazon's Ring unveils the $249 Ring Smart Lock, which uses a physical dial to recharge the battery when turned, set for a Q1 2027 launch, and five new cameras (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)
